_comment: Player-facing art for Queen Euphoria. `src` is relative to _work/incoming (gitignored originals); `out` lands in assets/handouts. Order here is the order pages appear in the journal. Run: npm run handouts

handouts.name: Euphoria
handouts.caption: The megasimsense star herself. Show when the Johnson names the target (p.8-10), and again when the runners finally reach her.

handouts.name: SIMSTAR — Cover (Jungle Huntress)
handouts.caption: Trade press. Teases JUNGLE HUNTRESS as her next sensation and the Amber Gel weekend tour — the same tour the kidnapping is timed to spoil.

handouts.name: SIMSTAR — Cover (Inside the Senses of a Sim Queen)
handouts.caption: Second cover. Legwork handout: a Simstar back issue is the obvious place a runner starts reading up on her.

handouts.src: Amber Gel Adverts/Amber Gel_ Euphoria Advertisement.png
handouts.name: Amber Gel — Strice Foods Banner
handouts.caption: The full campaign board, Strice Foods branded. Carries the whole appearance schedule: Friday Renraku Arcology, Saturday South End Coliseum, Sunday Aztechnology Pyramid Park.

handouts.name: Amber Gel — Weekend Appearances Poster
handouts.caption: Street poster version of the same schedule.

handouts.name: EUPHORIA LIVE — Flyposted Bill
handouts.caption: Weathered and flyposted. The Barrens version of the ad — use it in Puyallup and Redmond where the clean corporate board would look out of place.

handouts.src: Amber Gel Adverts/ChatGPT Image Aug 26, 2026, 01_46_03 PM (3).png
handouts.name: Amber Gel — Weekend Appearances (alt)
handouts.caption: Alternate poster treatment.

handouts.name: Off and Running — The Meet
handouts.caption: The Fixer's meet with Ludivenko's Johnson (p.8-10). Read-aloud opener for Act 1.

handouts.name: Pacific Towers — Exterior
handouts.caption: Euphoria's building. First thing the team sees when they case the place.

handouts.name: Pacific Towers — Lobby
handouts.caption: The lobby, empty. Establishing shot.

handouts.name: Pacific Towers — Lobby, Security Desk
handouts.caption: Same lobby with the guard station staffed. Use this one when the runners have to talk their way past.

handouts.name: Pacific Towers — Lobby Layout (reference)
handouts.caption: Annotated layout: entrance and guard station, mail, bar, meeting room, garden, lecture room, store room, pool, restrooms. Reference art, NOT a battle map — the playable scene is 'Pacific Towers Lobby'.

handouts.name: Pacific Towers — Bar
handouts.caption: Ground-floor bar. A plausible place to loiter while watching the lifts.

handouts.name: Pacific Towers — Pool
handouts.caption: Building pool.

handouts.name: Euphoria's Condo — Living Room
handouts.caption: The penthouse as the runners find it (p.30-33). Where the sim-rig kept recording through the raid.

handouts.name: Euphoria's Condo — Layout (reference)
handouts.caption: Annotated floorplan, 21st floor: entrance hall, foyer, living room, recording studio, greenhouse balcony, kitchen, workout room, bedrooms and baths. Reference art, NOT a battle map — the playable scene is 'Euphoria's Condo'.

handouts.name: Royal Meadows — Exterior
handouts.caption: The cheap block where Euphoria is actually held in Act 1 (p.12).

handouts.name: Royal Meadows — Lobby
handouts.caption: Manager's window and the security cage. About 100 nuyen calms the building manager down if the runners annoy him.

handouts.name: Royal Meadows — Flat Layout (reference)
handouts.caption: The four rooms of the flat: living room/kitchenette, bedroom, closet, bathroom. Matches the book's 8 x 3 metre unit. Reference art, NOT a battle map — the playable scene is 'Royal Meadows Flat'.

handouts.name: Royal Meadows — Flat, Interior
handouts.caption: Flat 812 from the door. Two double beds squeezed side by side, nowhere to take cover, nowhere to flank.

handouts.name: Royal Meadows — Flat, Interior (alt angle)
handouts.caption: Second view of the same flat. The dresser and closet hold women's clothing in average size, still in plastic wrap — bought for Euphoria, not by her.
